description: Class representing a table of figures.

Delete.description: Removes the table of figures from the document.
Delete.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetCaption.description: Returns the caption label that the table of figures is built from (for example, "Figure").
GetCaption.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTableOfFigures class.
GetClassType.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetIncludeLabel.description: Returns whether the caption label and number are included in the table of figures entries.
GetIncludeLabel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetIncludePageNumbers.description: Returns whether page numbers are shown in the table of figures.
GetIncludePageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetParent.description: Returns the document that contains the table of figures.
GetParent.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetRange.description: Returns a range that covers the entire table of figures.
GetRange.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetRightAlignPageNumbers.description: Returns whether page numbers are right-aligned in the table of figures.
GetRightAlignPageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetUseHyperlinks.description: Returns whether entries are formatted as hyperlinks.
GetUseHyperlinks.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetCaption.description: Sets the caption label that the table of figures is built from (for example, "Figure").
SetCaption.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetIncludeLabel.description: Specifies whether the caption label and number are included in the table of figures entries.
SetIncludeLabel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetIncludePageNumbers.description: Specifies whether page numbers are shown in the table of figures.
SetIncludePageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetPr.description: Applies the specified properties to the table of figures and rebuilds it.
SetPr.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetRightAlignPageNumbers.description: Specifies whether page numbers are right-aligned in the table of figures.
SetRightAlignPageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetUseHyperlinks.description: Specifies whether entries are formatted as hyperlinks.
SetUseHyperlinks.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Update.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
